entries.text: Allah's Name to commence with, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
All praise is due to Allah, the Owner of all the worlds.
The Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
The Owner of the Day of Recompense.
You alone may we worship, and from You alone may we seek help.
Enable us to walk the Straight Path.
The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favour.
Not of those who were subjected to (Your) wrath nor of the astray ones.
